text:
**I’d pick First Direct for a personal current account if what matters most is being able to speak to someone when something goes wrong.** You can call a UK-based adviser 24/7, and First Direct earned five out of five stars for both customer service and telephone banking in the 2026 Which? survey. ([firstdirect.com](https://www.firstdirect.com/ways-to-bank/?utm_source=openai))

Two alternatives stand out, depending on how you bank:

- **Monzo for overall service.** In the August 2026 Ipsos survey, Monzo ranked first in both Great Britain and Northern Ireland: 79% and 82% of its customers, respectively, were very or extremely likely to recommend it. That measures the whole banking experience, not just how well support handles a problem. ([uk.virginmoney.com](https://uk.virginmoney.com/current-accounts/service-quality-indicators/?utm_source=openai))
- **Nationwide for face-to-face help.** It ranked first for branch service in Great Britain: 83% of customers surveyed would recommend its branches, compared with 71% for runner-up Halifax. ([uk.virginmoney.com](https://uk.virginmoney.com/current-accounts/service-quality-indicators/))
